meta.title: Auto-routing to the auction team leaves the stage in Draft
gaps: Enable or verify routeAuctionsToAuctionTeam and ensure the publisher is outside the auction team.
Verify the auction-team assignment after publishing; no catalog step or known assignment label exposes it.
Verify the auction stage's status independently of the event-list status label.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enable or verify routeAuctionsToAuctionTeam and ensure the publisher is outside the auction team.; Verify the auction-team assignment after publishing; no catalog step or known assignment label exposes it.; Verify the auction stage's status independently of the event-list status label.

steps.note: Start with the default Auction stage under the required preconfigured routing gate.
Give the auction a unique title for the post-publish lookup.
Provide a line item so missing content cannot explain a Draft outcome.
Trigger auction-team routing through Publish, not Save as draft.
Check that publishing did not report an application error.
Inspect the publisher's resulting event status.
Look for the routed auction among drafts.
Assert the created event is present and labelled Draft; this does not prove auction-team assignment.
